description: A React functional component that provides a user interface for entering and saving a proxy URL. It displays the current URL with the entered proxy URL appended as a query parameter upon saving.

methods.name: EnterProxyUrl
methods.description: React functional component that manages proxy URL input, saving state, and displays a clickable URL with the proxy parameter.

methods.name: handleUrlChange
methods.description: Event handler to update the proxy URL state when the input value changes, and reset the saved status.

methods.name: handleSaveClick
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the Save button is clicked, setting the saved status to true.
